Context: 4. Block years and carry forward of L TC

Example.the two blocks of 2022-2023 and 2024-2025.  
- In respect of 2022-2023, he can avail the concession to Home town before the grace period, i.e., by 31-12-2024. Then he is entitled to carry forward his LTC to anywhere in India to be availed before
1. the grace period, i.e., by 31-12-2026.
